name: Multiplayer Edit
description: Collaborate with friends in real-time level editing! Host a session and build together.

issues.info: Please report any bugs or crashes on the GitHub issues page.

signaling-url.name: Signaling Server URL
signaling-url.description: URL of the signaling server used for connection setup. Only change this if you're self-hosting your own signaling server.

ice-transport-mode.name: Connection Mode
ice-transport-mode.description: How to connect to other players. Auto is recommended. STUN Only is direct connection only. TURN Only routes through a relay.

player-name.name: Player Name
player-name.description: Your display name in multiplayer sessions. Leave empty to automatically use your username.

customize-appearance.name: Cursor Customization
customize-appearance.description: Customize your editor cursor style and multiplayer color.

show-cursors.name: Show Player Cursors
show-cursors.description: Display other players' cursor positions in the editor.

show-offscreen-indicators.name: Off-Screen Indicators
show-offscreen-indicators.description: Show pointers at the screen edges for players who are off-screen.

show-chat-bubbles.name: Show Chat Bubbles
show-chat-bubbles.description: Display chat bubbles above players when they send messages.

chat-bubble-duration.name: Chat Bubble Duration
chat-bubble-duration.description: How long (in seconds) chat bubbles stay visible.

chat-filter.name: Chat Filter
chat-filter.description: Filters profanity in lobby names and chat.

check-updates.name: Check for Updates
check-updates.description: Automatically check for newer versions when opening the Multiplayer menu.

funny-loading-messages.name: Funny Loading Messages
funny-loading-messages.description: Show flavor text while connecting to a host.

cloud-hosting-url.name: Cloud Hosting URL (WIP)
cloud-hosting-url.description: The URL of the dedicated server used for uploading and hosting local levels.

cloud-auth-token.name: Cloud Auth Token
cloud-auth-token.description: Your private token for uploading and managing levels on the Cloud Server. Get this from the server admin.
